description: Rate an AI deployment against The Insurable AI Standard and seal an Insurability Certificate into Bitcoin. Composes an Insurability Level (I-0 UNRATED to I-4 PRE-CLEARED) from PROVABLE controls: its Verified-Source domain and its MCP-Shield code are checked live against sealed proofs (VERIFIED); logging, human accountability and payment pre-clearance are declared (ATTESTED). Returns the level, the pillar evidence and a sealed certificate code (IC-XXXX-XXXX) any insurer can verify. Records controls, not a guarantee against loss.

decisions.description: Attest: every AI decision is sealed (Art 12 logging)

human.description: Attest: a named human is accountable, actions carry a signed permission

mcp_code.description: An MCP-Shield code MS-XXXX-XXXX, to verify the 'Tools guarded' pillar (optional)

precleared.description: Attest: no autonomous payment fires without a sealed sign-off (Witness-Proof)

source_domain.description: A sebbi Verified-Source domain, to verify the 'Inputs sourced' pillar (optional)

name: sebbi_insurability
title: Rate an AI deployment's insurability
